Emergency Medical Services, Annual: Total Calls To Emergency Medical Services

column4: Non-Emergency Calls refer to cases where urgent medical assistance by the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) Emergency Medical Services (EMS) is not required.  Examples of non-emergencies include toothaches, diarrhoea, coughs, headaches, slight burns or scalds, constipation, or medical check-ups.

Emergency Medical Services, Annual: Emergency Medical Services - False Alarm Calls
column4: False alarm calls include incidents where calls were cancelled or where no patients were found at the scene upon the arrival of the ambulance crew.
